§6Arsenic§f

§aCheap bismuth replacement for circuits. Poison on the side.§f

§bArsenic§f (As, atomic 33) is mostly made in nugget form. Its main trick: replacing bismuth in the §bVersatile Integrated Circuit§f recipe. Same pattern, swap the nugget. Cheaper per unit, slightly less efficient.

§6Make It§f (Ore Acidizer):
§b•§f §e100 mB§f High-Performance Solvent
§b•§f 16 Oily Scraps
§b•§f Output: §eArsenic Nugget§f

§6What It Is For§f:
§b•§f §bVersatile Integrated Circuit§f, replaces bismuth nugget in the recipe
§b•§f §bArsenic Bronze§f, alloy with copper and flux

§ePS:§f Oily scraps come from oil processing. If your refinery is automated, arsenic production scales for free alongside your petrochemical chain. Mass-produce circuits without burning through your bismuth stockpile.
